item.name: Three_Wash_Basins
item.description: Three Rubbermaid Commercial 7.6-gallon bus boxes, model FG335100GRAY.
item.readyBeforeUse: The three basins are empty, visibly clean, and do not leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: The basins are empty, visibly clean, air-dry, nested, and stored. No liquid has reached the playa.
item.ifNotReady: Do not wash food-contact items in a dirty or leaking basin. Tell the Food Lead.
